_: RUNNING THE INSTITUTION — premises, compliance, assurance and governance.
The College teaches online and is administered from London. It keeps a
registered office and a small serviced office for the leadership and
the registry; teaching staff work remotely.

gbpPerYear.s: A London registered office and mail address at £24.99 a month. The Hoxton Mix, virtual office pricing — hoxtonmix.com/virtual-office-london-old-street, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

gbpPerDeskMonth.s: Serviced office desk, Farringdon — the London submarket closest to the City at a mid-market rate (the index runs £620 Shoreditch to £865 Soho). LondonOffices.com, London office cost price index 2026 — londonoffices.com/london-office-cost-price-index-2026, published 11 Sep 2026

deskShareOfNonTeachingStaff.s: Leadership, registry and administration work hybrid; one desk for every two

insurance.name: Insurance: professional indemnity, employers' liability, cyber

usdPerYear.s: A planning allowance for professional indemnity, public and employers' liability, cyber and directors' cover. The published price for a small education business is far lower — £457.52 a year for £10 million of public and employers' liability with professional indemnity (Simply Business, education insurance, data 1 Jan–30 Jun 2026) — but an institution that holds learners' records and confers awards carries cover a consultancy does not. Employers' liability of at least £5 million is a legal requirement (GOV.UK, Employers' liability insurance)

shareOfRevenue.s: Premiums rise with turnover and enrolment

policy.s: At the scale of this plan the College meets two of the three small-company tests — turnover up to £15 million, assets up to £7.5 million, 50 employees or fewer — and is exempt from statutory audit (GOV.UK, Audit exemptions for private limited companies, retrieved 23 Sep 2026). It is audited anyway, from its second year, because founders and a Board require audited accounts

gbpByTurnoverGbp.s: Audit fee by the previous year's turnover, at the top of each published band: under £1 million £3,000–£6,000; £1–5 million £5,000–£12,000; £5–15 million £10,000–£25,000. Audit Group, statutory audit costs 2025/26 — auditgroup.co.uk/statutory-audit-costs, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

accounting.name: Accounting system, payroll and tax compliance

gbpPerMonth.s: Xero Comprehensive, £55 a month. Xero, UK pricing plans — xero.com/uk/pricing-plans, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

gbpPerPayslipMonth.s: Xero payroll, £1.00 to £1.50 for each person paid; the top of the range. Xero, UK pricing plans — xero.com/uk/pricing-plans, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

gbpPerYear.s: Year-end accounts and corporation tax return prepared externally, at the top of the published range for a limited company (£1,200–£1,800); the Head of Finance keeps the books. Sleek UK, cost of running a limited company — sleek.com/uk/resources/cost-of-running-a-limited-company, published 10 Aug 2026

usdPerYear.s: Contracts, agreements with institutional buyers, employment and data protection advice

usdOnce.s: Incorporation, the academic and governance instruments, learner terms and contracts, drafted and reviewed before the first intake

gbpPerYear.s: ICO data protection fee, tier 2 (small and medium organisations), £78 a year. Information Commissioner's Office — ico.org.uk/for-organisations/data-protection-fee, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

examiners.s: One External Examiner for each pair of levels, one of whom is appointed Chief External Examiner

gbpPerExaminerYear.s: University of Essex annual fee for an undergraduate award of nine or more modules, £600 — a floor, dated to 2024/25. University of Essex, Fees and expenses for external examiners — essex.ac.uk/staff/academic-standards-and-quality/fees-and-expenses-external-examiners, retrieved 23 Sep 2026

chiefSupplementGbp.s: Supplement for a Senior External Examiner, £150 (University of Dundee, policy and code of practice on external examining — dundee.ac.uk, AY2024-25)

accreditation.name: Independent accreditation: British Accreditation Council, Online, Distance and Blended Learning

why.s: The College applies for accreditation of its online provision once three years of teaching can be inspected. A cost of seeking recognition; not a claim the College holds it

applicationGbp.s: Application fee, non-refundable. British Accreditation Council, Guide to Accreditation and Inspection Fees 2026/27 — the-bac.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/BAC-Fees-Brochure-2026-27.pdf

inspectionManagementGbp.s: Inspection management fee, UK provider. British Accreditation Council, Guide to Accreditation and Inspection Fees 2026/27 — the-bac.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/BAC-Fees-Brochure-2026-27.pdf

inspectionGbp.s: Inspection fee, three inspectors for three days — the top of the table (£865 for one inspector for one day). British Accreditation Council, Guide to Accreditation and Inspection Fees 2026/27 — the-bac.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/BAC-Fees-Brochure-2026-27.pdf

interimInspectionGbp.s: Interim inspection within twelve months of accreditation, £992 a day (UK); one day. British Accreditation Council, Guide to Accreditation and Inspection Fees 2026/27 — the-bac.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/BAC-Fees-Brochure-2026-27.pdf

cycleYears.s: Accreditation runs for four years before full re-inspection. British Accreditation Council, Guide to Accreditation and Inspection Fees 2026/27 — the-bac.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/BAC-Fees-Brochure-2026-27.pdf

annualGbpByEnrolled.s: Annual accreditation fee by learners enrolled: £1,842 up to 3,000; £3,070 to 8,000; £3,930 above. British Accreditation Council, Guide to Accreditation and Inspection Fees 2026/27 — the-bac.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/BAC-Fees-Brochure-2026-27.pdf

gbpOnce.s: Incorporation of a private limited company online, £100. Companies House fees — gov.uk/government/publications/companies-house-fees/companies-house-fees, updated 2 Jul 2026

gbpPerYear.s: Annual confirmation statement filed online, £50. Companies House fees — gov.uk/government/publications/companies-house-fees/companies-house-fees, updated 2 Jul 2026

usdPerMemberYear.s: An honorarium and expenses for four meetings a year
